name: Midnight Onyx Lighter
short_description: Hand-set jet black crystals on a matte obsidian base.
long_description: The Midnight Onyx Lighter is a study in shadow and light. Each jet-black Swarovski crystal is individually hand-placed over a premium windproof body. It offers a weight that feels substantial in the hand and a sparkle that reveals itself only when the light hits just right. A perfect companion for late-night cocktails and dimly lit lounges.
image_prompt: High-end product photography of a matte black lighter encrusted with black crystals, moody lighting, dark marble background, shallow depth of field.

name: Champagne Shower Lighter
short_description: A bubbly gradient of gold and clear crystals.
long_description: Celebrate the everyday with the Champagne Shower Lighter. This piece features a sophisticated gradient transition from deep amber gold at the base to clear brilliant white at the lid. The multi-sized crystals create a 'bubbling' effect reminiscent of a freshly poured glass of vintage champagne. Elegant, festive, and unapologetically bright.
image_prompt: Close-up of a gold and clear crystal lighter on a reflective glass surface, warm golden hour lighting, blurred champagne bubbles in background.

name: Emerald Envy Lighter
short_description: Deep forest green crystals with a high-gloss finish.
long_description: Inspired by the lush depth of rare emeralds, this lighter is fully encrusted in rich forest-green stones. The monochromatic design emphasizes the texture of the crystals and the precision of the hand-application. It is a bold statement piece that brings a touch of regal sophistication to any collection.
image_prompt: Product shot of a deep green crystal lighter sitting on a dark velvet cloth, dramatic side lighting, focused on crystal texture.

name: Aurora Rose Lighter
short_description: Iridescent pink crystals with a holographic shift.
long_description: The Aurora Rose Lighter captures the shifting colors of a morning sky. Using premium Aurora Borealis crystals with a rose-tinted base, this lighter shifts from soft pink to shimmering violet as it moves. It is playful, feminine, and possesses a magical quality that makes it a constant conversation starter.
image_prompt: Holographic pink crystal lighter on a clean white pedestal, soft pastel lighting, ethereal aesthetic.

name: Frostbite Silver Lighter
short_description: Pristine clear crystals over a polished rhodium base.
long_description: For those who prefer the classics, the Frostbite Silver Lighter is the ultimate luxury essential. Encrusted entirely in 'Diamond Clear' crystals, it offers maximum brilliance and a clean, icy aesthetic. It matches everything, shines everywhere, and embodies the 'Jeweled Store' standard of uncompromising sparkle.
image_prompt: Bright, high-key photography of a silver crystal lighter on a light gray stone background, sharp focus, sparkling reflections.

name: Prism Lighter Case
short_description: A removable sleeve with rainbow geometric crystal patterns.
long_description: Transform your everyday lighter into a work of art. The Prism Lighter Case features a geometric arrangement of multi-colored crystals that catch and refract light like a crystal prism. Designed to fit standard slim lighters, it allows you to carry luxury in your pocket without committing to a single device.
image_prompt: Hand holding a colorful crystal lighter sleeve, urban chic aesthetic, soft bokeh city lights in background.

name: Rose Gold Mesh Sleeve
short_description: Flexible rose gold mesh with scattered crystal accents.
long_description: A softer approach to sparkle. This flexible mesh sleeve slides easily onto your lighter, featuring a delicate weave of rose gold-toned metal and tiny, scattered crystals. It offers a tactile, fabric-like feel while maintaining the high-shine luxury our customers expect.
image_prompt: Close-up of a rose gold mesh lighter cover, soft lighting, focus on the intricate metal weave and small crystals.

name: Quilted Crystal Shell
short_description: Classic quilted pattern rendered in clear and black crystals.
long_description: Inspired by high-fashion leatherwork, the Quilted Crystal Shell uses two tones of crystals to create a visual quilted texture. It is a nod to timeless luxury house aesthetics, reimagined for the modern accessory enthusiast. Sturdy, stylish, and unmistakably chic.
image_prompt: Luxury lighter case with black and clear crystal pattern, styled next to a designer handbag, clean studio lighting.

name: Leopard Luxe Sleeve
short_description: Animal print pattern using amber, chocolate, and black crystals.
long_description: Unleash your wild side with the Leopard Luxe Sleeve. This intricate piece uses three different shades of hand-set crystals to replicate a striking leopard pattern. It adds a playful yet sophisticated edge to your ensemble, proving that animal print is indeed a neutral.
image_prompt: Animal print crystal lighter sleeve on a wooden vanity, warm lighting, luxurious feel.

name: Gilded Lily Small Case
short_description: A compact rectangular case with floral crystal motifs.
long_description: Perfect for jewelry, mints, or small essentials, the Gilded Lily Small Case is a masterpiece of miniature design. The lid features an intricate lily motif crafted from gold and pearl-finish crystals. The interior is lined with plush velvet to protect your most precious items.
image_prompt: Open small crystal case showing a velvet interior, soft lighting, styled with a few pieces of gold jewelry nearby.

name: Velvet Night Pill Box
short_description: Sleek oval pill box encrusted in deep navy crystals.
long_description: Discretion meets decadence. The Velvet Night Pill Box is a slim, palm-sized container encrusted in deep sapphire and navy crystals. It clicks shut with a satisfying precision and fits effortlessly into the smallest evening clutch. A practical item turned into a private luxury.
image_prompt: Sapphire blue crystal pill box held between fingers, showing its small size, elegant hand with clean manicure.

name: Starlet Compact Mirror
short_description: Double-sided mirror with a starburst crystal exterior.
long_description: The Starlet Compact is designed for the spotlight. The exterior features a dramatic starburst pattern of varying crystal sizes, radiating from a central large stone. Inside, you'll find a standard and a 2x magnifying mirror, ensuring you're always ready for your close-up.
image_prompt: Sparkling crystal compact mirror, closed, lying on a silk scarf, bright and glamorous lighting.

name: Diamond Dust Lip Balm
short_description: Refillable crystal-encrusted case with organic peppermint balm.
long_description: Elevate your beauty routine with the Diamond Dust Lip Balm. The heavy, gold-plated tube is fully encrusted in shimmering clear crystals. The balm itself is a proprietary blend of organic shea butter and cooling peppermint, providing a subtle sheen and deep hydration. Once finished, the case can be refilled with any of our signature balms.
image_prompt: Crystal lip balm tube with the cap off, showing the smooth balm inside, clean and bright cosmetic photography style.

name: Petal Soft Lip Treatment
short_description: Rose-gold crystal case with a tinted rose-infused balm.
long_description: The Petal Soft Lip Treatment offers a hint of color and a wealth of luxury. Encased in a rose-gold and pink crystal tube, this balm is infused with real rose otto oil for a delicate scent and a sheer, healthy glow. It's the perfect intersection of skincare and high-end jewelry.
image_prompt: Rose gold crystal lip balm tube styled with fresh pink rose petals, soft and romantic lighting.

name: Silk & Stone Hand Cream
short_description: Crystal-capped travel tube with neroli and jasmine cream.
long_description: Keep luxury at your fingertips. Our Silk & Stone Hand Cream comes in a sleek, aluminum travel tube topped with a custom-bejeweled cap. The cream is fast-absorbing and scented with a sophisticated blend of neroli and night-blooming jasmine. It leaves skin feeling like silk and smelling like a Mediterranean garden.
image_prompt: A hand cream tube with a sparkling crystal cap, modern minimalist bathroom setting, soft natural light.

name: Moonlit Glow Body Balm
short_description: Jeweled glass jar with a shimmer-infused vanilla body butter.
long_description: Indulge in the Moonlit Glow. This rich, whipped body butter is housed in a heavy glass jar with a lid completely covered in hand-set iridescent crystals. The formula contains ethically sourced mica for a subtle, 'lit-from-within' shimmer and a warm, comforting vanilla bean scent.
image_prompt: Elegant glass jar with a crystal lid, some cream visible, cozy and warm lighting, styled on a nightstand.

name: Custom Initial Keychain
short_description: A heavy-weight keychain customized with your crystal-set initial.
long_description: Personalization meets brilliance. Choose your initial and your crystal colorway, and our artisans will hand-set each stone onto a solid brass base. It's a small way to carry your identity with a significant amount of sparkle. Each piece is made to order with a lead time of 7 days.
image_prompt: A sparkling crystal initial 'B' keychain hanging from a set of car keys, lifestyle photography, blurred luxury car interior in background.

name: Bespoke Crystal Flask
short_description: A stainless steel flask customized with your design or monogram.
long_description: The ultimate custom gift. Our 6oz stainless steel flask can be fully encrusted with your choice of patterns, monograms, or solid colors. Work directly with our design team to create a one-of-a-kind piece that reflects your personal style. Ideal for weddings, milestones, or simply the person who has everything.
image_prompt: A fully crystal-covered flask with a custom monogram, dramatic lighting, styled in a home bar setting.

name: Personalized Sparkle Phone Grip
short_description: A high-quality phone grip bejeweled in your choice of colors.
long_description: Because your most-used device deserves to shine. This sturdy, collapsible phone grip is transformed into a jewelry piece with hand-placed crystals in your choice of ombre, solid, or striped patterns. It's the easiest way to add a touch of Jeweled Store luxury to your daily life.
image_prompt: Close-up of a hand holding a smartphone with a sparkling crystal phone grip, modern lifestyle aesthetic.

name: Signature Jeweled Vanity Tray
short_description: A mirror-base tray with a crystal-encrusted perimeter.
long_description: The foundation of a beautiful vanity. Our Signature Tray features a high-clarity mirrored base surrounded by a raised border encrusted in three rows of brilliant clear crystals. Custom color options are available for the border to match your room's aesthetic. A stunning way to display your Jeweled Store collection.
image_prompt: A mirrored vanity tray with a crystal border, holding various perfume bottles and lighters, bright airy bedroom lighting.
